parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, description, type, status, price, quantity, updated_at, is_deleted 
FROM spares_history;

SELECT 
  id AS "spareCode", 
  name AS "spareName", 
  COALESCE(description, '') AS "spareDescription", 
  COALESCE(type, '') AS "spareType", 
  COALESCE(status, '') AS "spareStatus", 
  trim_scale(price)::text AS "price", 
  quantity AS "quantity", 
  COALESCE(updated_at, '') AS "updatedAt" 
FROM spares_history 
WHERE is_deleted = FALSE 
ORDER BY id;

INSERT INTO spares_history (id, name, description, type, status, price, quantity, updated_at, last_synced_at, is_deleted) 
SELECT src."spareCode", src."spareName", src."spareDescription", src."spareType", src."spareStatus", src."price", src."quantity", src."updatedAt", NOW(), FALSE 
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb -> 'insert') AS src("spareCode" text, "spareName" text, "spareDescription" text, "spareType" text, "spareStatus" text, "price" numeric, "quantity" integer, "updatedAt" text) 
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

UPDATE spares_history AS target 
SET 
  name = payload."spareName", 
  description = payload."spareDescription", 
  type = payload."spareType", 
  status = payload."spareStatus", 
  price = payload."price", 
  quantity = payload."quantity", 
  updated_at = payload."updatedAt", 
  last_synced_at = NOW(), 
  is_deleted = FALSE, 
  deleted_at = NULL 
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb -> 'update') AS payload("spareCode" text, "spareName" text, "spareDescription" text, "spareType" text, "spareStatus" text, "price" numeric, "quantity" integer, "updatedAt" text) 
WHERE target.id = payload."spareCode";

UPDATE spares_history 
SET is_deleted = TRUE, deleted_at = NOW() 
WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb -> 'delete'));
